column1: # tests/fixtures/tapebin/frozen.tsv -- Tapebin v1 carriers written by the seed's Python codec (its tapebin.py encode,
# archived with the seed), frozen 2026-10-23 at e3c4b123 while the seed was still importable (plans/unisa-detach.md
# They are the reference side of the carrier checks that used to call that codec per run: tests/tapereadercheck.cx
# (origin-*, unit2, torture), tests/tapebinproduct.cx (calls) and tests/tapebincodec.cx (codec-*).  Read through
# tests/cxlib/tapebinfix.cx, which refuses a row whose hex does not hash to bytes_sha256 or whose source text, as the
# calling check spells it, does not hash to text_sha256.  Capture, once: for each row,
#   encode(TEXT) (origin 0) or encode(TEXT, origin_target=ORIGIN) of the seed's tapebin module, hex-dumped; TEXT is the check's own
#   literal.  There is no regeneration path: the codec is archived.  A row changes only by a deliberate re-freeze
#   from the C codecs (the reference's and the product's --tapebin -c must agree byte for byte), recorded here.
# Columns: name, origin target id (0 none, 1 lnx/x86_64 .. 6 win/arm64), sha256 of the source text, sha256 of the
# carrier, the carrier as lowercase hex.
